title: A fourth-moment bound by one Fourier coefficient
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Its vector Fourier fourth moment, the sum of the fourth powers of all its vector Fourier coefficients, is at most the square of some one of those coefficients.
